text: dsh-openspec-opsx 将 OpenSpec 规格驱动工作流接入 DSH，注册 12 个 openspec-* 技能和 12 个 /opsx-* 斜杠命令，供所有 agent preset 使用。用户可从探索想法、提出变更和创建规划产物，继续到应用任务、验证实现、同步规格及归档。命令会注入相应工作流提示并附加用户输入，模型也能按描述调用技能。适合希望在 DSH 中按 OpenSpec 方式规划和推进软件变更的开发者。目标项目需有 OpenSpec root，且 openspec CLI 位于 PATH；不需要 API key。

dsh-openspec-opsx adds OpenSpec skills and /opsx-* commands to DSH. They help explore and plan changes, apply tasks, verify work, sync specs, and archive changes. Commands attach user arguments to workflow prompts; models invoke skills by description. Requires an OpenSpec project and CLI.
想在 DSH 里用 OpenSpec 来规划和推进代码变更。
有没有能帮我先探索需求、再生成开发计划的工作流？
I want DSH agents to follow OpenSpec workflows for planning and implementing changes.
dsh-openspec-opsx 的「工作流斜杠命令」功能：提供 /opsx-* 命令来探索、创建、继续、应用和验证 OpenSpec 变更。用户选择命令并输入参数即可触发；插件把对应提示内容和输入交给当前 agent。
dsh-openspec-opsx 的「模型可调用技能」功能：注册 OpenSpec 的 openspec-* 工作流技能，供模型根据描述选择调用。注册时标记为模型可调用，技能正文由插件从随包文件载入；技能包含探索需求和澄清规格等流程指引。

dsh-openspec-opsx README · dsh-openspec-opsx：English | [中文](README.zh.md)

Bring [OpenSpec](https://github.com/Fission-AI/OpenSpec)'s spec-driven development workflows into DeepSeek Harness: **12 `openspec-*` skills** plus **12 `/opsx-*` slash commands**.

dsh-openspec-opsx README · dsh-openspec-opsx：- No runtime dependencies beyond the host's own `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm`; no third-party skill kit.
- Every command declares `input.hint`, so the composer highlights it and waits for arguments instead of firing immediately.
- A command injects OpenSpec's own generated workflow prompt; whatever you type after the command is appended under `## 用户输入`.
- Skill bodies and command prompts are generated verbatim by `openspec init --tools claude`; this repository only wires them into DSH.

dsh-openspec-opsx README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-openspec-opsx
```

Restart DSH afterwards. install from GitHub:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:IDrinkMoreWater/dsh-openspec-opsx
```

dsh-openspec-opsx README · Commands：| Command | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `/opsx-propose` | Create a change and generate all planning artifacts in one step |
| `/opsx-explore` | Explore mode: think before committing |
| `/opsx-new` | Scaffold a new change |
| `/opsx-continue` | Create the next artifact in dependency order |
| `/opsx-ff` | Fast-forward every planning artifact |
| `/opsx-apply` | Implement tasks from `tasks.md` |
| `/opsx-update` | Revise planning artifacts coherently |
| `/opsx-verify` | Verify implementation matches artifacts |
| `/opsx-sync` | Merge delta specs into main specs |
| `/opsx-archive` | Archive a completed change |
| `/opsx-bulk-archive` | Archive several changes at once |
| `/opsx-onboard` | Guided walkthrough of the whole workflow |

dsh-openspec-opsx README · Commands：```text
/opsx-explore should the CLI grow a --watch mode
/opsx-propose move login from sessions to JWT
```

dsh-openspec-opsx README · Skills：`openspec-propose`, `openspec-explore`, `openspec-new-change`, `openspec-continue-change`, `openspec-ff-change`, `openspec-apply-change`, `openspec-update-change`, `openspec-verify-change`, `openspec-sync-specs`, `openspec-archive-change`, `openspec-bulk-archive-change`, `openspec-onboard`.

The model loads one by description when the task matches; you can also ask for it explicitly.

dsh-openspec-opsx README · Why not `/opsx:explore`：DSH's command-name grammar is `/^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]*$/u` — a colon is not a legal character. Claude Code's `/opsx:explore` can only be `/opsx-explore` here.

dsh-openspec-opsx README · Prerequisites：- The target project needs an OpenSpec root: `openspec init` (or `openspec init --tools none`, since this plugin already ships the skills).
- The `openspec` CLI must be on `PATH`. This package's content is generated from **OpenSpec 1.14.3**.

dsh-openspec-opsx README · Regenerate for a newer OpenSpec：```sh
npm i -g @fission-ai/openspec@latest
node scripts/sync-openspec.mjs
```

The script runs `openspec init --tools claude` in a temporary directory (after opening the global workflow profile to all twelve workflows) and overwrites `skills/` and `commands/`. Commit the output so version drift stays reviewable.

dsh-openspec-opsx README · Layout：```text
index.js              registers skills and commands
skills/openspec-*/    12 SKILL.md files
commands/*.md         12 workflow prompts
cordis.patch.yml      bundle patch layer
